title: Cheese Wheels and Crocks of Butter
summary: Two loads wait in Eastmere: cheese wheels for Clem Yoxall and crocks of butter for Sunniva Hartwell. Dane Shearer wants them moved before the buyers come up the drove road.
offer_text: "Two things are late and both are mine to answer for. Clem Yoxall waits on cheese wheels and Sunniva Hartwell on crocks of butter. Fetch them in any order, before the buyers come up the drove road."
turn_in_text: "Both in. I shall sleep tonight, which is rare."

objectives.text: Take 3 cheese wheels from the dairy yard
Take 3 crocks of butter from the second stack
Hand the cheese wheels to Clem Yoxall
Hand the crocks of butter to Sunniva Hartwell
Tell Dane Shearer both are in
